# testdata

Captured files read by this crate's tests. Unlike `fixtures/`, these are not
reference outputs: they are files written by earlier versions of this crate,
kept so compatibility paths are tested against real data. They are never
edited or re-captured to make a failing test pass.

| file | what it is |
| --- | --- |
| `keystore_v1_snapshot.bin` | An `accounts.mks` in format version 1: `Keystore::create` then two `add`s, an imported root `0xB7 * 32` under the tag `0x1A * 20` (via v1's `import_with_unverified_tag`, since removed) and `F-derive-account-1`. 242 bytes = `22 + 2*94 + 32`. Read by `src/keystore/format.rs`'s version-dispatch test and by `tests/keystore.rs::a_version_1_store_is_refused_with_upgrade_not_damage`. |
| `keystore_v2_snapshot.bin` | An `accounts.mks` in format version 2: `Keystore::create` then two `add`s of the test harness's accounts, `imported_account()` (`F-address-widths`, tag `05ff…800f`) and `derived_account()` (`F-derive-account-1`, tag `4d9b…fbe9`), C-free configuration. 410 bytes = `22 + 2*178 + 32`; sha256 `590b2083…8520`. The imported record sorts first, so bytes 22..42 are its tag and byte 42 its kind, `1`, which `format::older_first_account` reads. Read by `src/keystore/format.rs`'s version-dispatch test and by `tests/keystore.rs::the_version_refusal_names_the_refused_stores_first_account_and_how_to_compare_it`. Captured from a real v2 encoder rather than forged from the v1 file. |
| `keystore_v3_snapshot.bin` | An `accounts.mks` in format version 3 at `Kdf::RECOMMENDED` (65536/3/1): `Keystore::create`, `adopt_master`, `add(Account::derive(master, 0))`, under the fixed password, salt, nonce seed and master given in `tests/keystore.rs::a_store_sealed_by_an_earlier_build_opens_and_is_reproduced_byte_for_byte`. 290 bytes = `51 + (45 + 178) + 16`. Tests the version-3 read path (arm 1 of that test) in both configurations. It checks compatibility, not correctness (the RFC 9106 vectors do that). |
| `keystore_v4_snapshot.bin` | An `accounts.mks` in format version 4 at `Kdf::RECOMMENDED` (65536/3/1), from the same three calls and fixed inputs as the v3 file, C-free configuration. 307 bytes = `51 + (45 + 195) + 16`; sha256 `828fcf6f…103c`. Arm 2 of `tests/keystore.rs::a_store_sealed_by_an_earlier_build_opens_and_is_reproduced_byte_for_byte`: the current build must reproduce it byte for byte. |
| `keystore_v3_reserved_snapshot.bin` | An `accounts.mks` in format version 3 with a reservation open, at `Kdf::CHEAP_FOR_TESTS` (8/1/1): `Keystore::create` under the harness's fixed password, salt and nonce seed, `adopt_master` (`F-address-widths`' master, `IMPORTED_MASTER`), `add(Account::derive(master, 0))` (tag `05ff…800f`, `IMPORTED_TAG`), then `persist_advance(&tag, &[0xD1; 32])`. 290 bytes = `51 + (45 + 178) + 16`; sha256 `b4d14a9b…8231`; generation 3, index 1, a reservation at 0, no recorded figures. Read by `src/keystore/format.rs`'s version-dispatch test and its `v3_state_2` malformation row, and through `open` by `tests/keystore.rs::a_version_3_reservation_is_read_with_its_figures_absent_and_still_resigns`, `tests/recon.rs::a_migrated_reservation_declines_to_classify` and `tests/cli.rs::a_migrated_store_says_its_figures_were_not_recorded_and_is_resealed_by_its_first_write`. |
